name: Europe
definition: Brexit, the EU or the EU referendum, including the effects of Brexit.

name: Immigration
definition: Immigration, migrants and border control, plus asylum seekers and refugees.

name: Economy
definition: The economy, jobs, taxes, public debt, inflation, cost of living or personal finances.

name: Health
definition: The NHS and health care, Covid-19, and the economic effects of Covid.

name: Inequality
definition: Poverty, inequality between rich and poor, housing and homelessness.

name: Environment
definition: Climate change, pollution, nature. One-word 'energy', 'food' or 'fuel' goes here.

name: Austerity/spending
definition: Public spending and services: education, welfare and benefits, cuts, social care, pensions.

name: Negativity
definition: Negative about politics or politicians in general, or about a named party or politician; a divided society.

name: Other lib-auth
definition: Crime, morals, national identity, racism, foreign affairs, war, defence, gender and family, social values.

name: Other left-right
definition: Left- or right-wing economic views, e.g. against capitalism and big business, or against socialism and red tape.

name: Other
definition: Constitution, devolution, Scottish independence, trade, emergencies, elections, transport, any other political issue.

name: Uncoded
definition: Unclear, too vague, not about politics or society, or impossible to place in one category.
